1.Description: Increases Anomaly Proficiency by <color=#2BAD00>96</color>. When the equipper triggers a <color=#FFA9DD>Refringe</color> reaction, they gain <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> increased Anomaly DMG, and all squad members gain <color=#2BAD00>30%</color> increased DMG dealt. Both effects last 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
